subject: GOBACK statement
notes: RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS by kb/Work PB892 (landed; closes this row). 'an exception condition is raised in the activating runtime element if checking for that exception condition is enabled in the activating runtime element' holds for every activation mechanism. ARM A (wave 48): an activation written as an OPERAND (function reference, inline method invocation, property accessor) is picked up and its RESUME lands at the statement it is written in (14.9.33.4 GR2 a) 2./3.). ARM B (wave 50): the staged slots now carry the identity of the ACTIVATING activation (ModuleStack.ActivatingActivation at staging), and a pickup takes a staging only when it runs IN that activation (ModuleStack.CurrentActivation). The anonymous run-unit-wide slot let an activator that emitted no pickup (an EC-free group) leave the condition for whichever EC-active pickup ran next: measured with two/three separately compiled modules, an EC-free main INVOKEs a method that ends GOBACK RAISING EXCEPTION EC-USER-BZ and a later EC-active program's INVOKE of a method raising nothing ran its declarative. The CALL-only registry discard (siteHandlesPropagation:false -> ApplyPropagationDefault) that hid the hole on the CALL path is deleted: one rule for CALL, INVOKE and function activations. The positive control (the checked activator INVOKEs the method itself) still raises the condition there. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Control/ProgramTable.cs#ApplyPropagationDefault (deleted by kb/Work PB892 Arm B - the CALL-only boundary discard is superseded by the activation-identity rule in ExceptionEngine (IsForThisActivation / ModuleStack.ActivatingActivation)) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/CodeGen/EmitterState.cs#OperandActivationResume (kb/Work PB1432 made the operand landing the ONE ResumeTransfer inside the operand-evaluation scope StatementEmitter.EmitStatement opens (OperandActivationResume became the private OperandEvaluationResume); the public method no longer exists) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/CodeGen/Verbs/OoEmitter.cs#EmitInvocationReturned (kb/Work PB3246: OoEmitter.EmitInvocationReturned is deleted; every INVOKE form and the CALL lane end in CallEmitter.EmitActivationReturned, which runs the pickup before the GR17 SORT termination)
